widgets.rebased: All lines start at 100 on the first day.
widgets.driftNote: Blue is above the target, red below. The grey area is the band that counts as on target.
widgets.benchmarkHint: No benchmark chosen yet. A broad world equity ETF is a common yardstick: flag one with "Use as a benchmark" and it appears here.
widgets.attributionNote: Blue added to your return, red took from it. The points add up to the return of the period.
widgets.noteEmpty: Empty note. Open the settings to write something.
widgets.correlationNote: Daily returns over {{window}}. +1 moves together, -1 moves oppositely.

widgetHelp.kpi: One figure with its change and trend: value, result, return, risk.
widgetHelp.value_history: Your value against the money you put in.
widgetHelp.price_chart: The price of one instrument with your buys and sales.
widgetHelp.performance_comparison: Your portfolio against benchmarks, all starting at 100.
widgetHelp.allocation: How your portfolio is divided, as a donut or treemap.
widgetHelp.drift_bars: How far each sleeve is from its target.
widgetHelp.holdings_table: Your positions with value, weight and result.
widgetHelp.returns_heatmap: Which positions gained and which lost in the period.
widgetHelp.monthly_returns: Return of each month, year by year.
widgetHelp.look_through: What your ETFs hold underneath. Needs ETF data (later).
widgetHelp.drawdown: How far below its peak your portfolio has been.
widgetHelp.return_bridge: From start value to end value: what you added and what each position gained.
widgetHelp.attribution: How much each position added to or took from your return, in euro and in percentage points.
widgetHelp.macro_overlay: An economic indicator against a position (later).
widgetHelp.news_feed: News linked to what you hold (later).
widgetHelp.signals: Recommendations and alerts waiting for you (later).
